Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 58

“And when, like a tortoise drawing in its limbs, one withdraws the senses entirely from their objects, that one's wisdom is firmly set.”

A homely, exact image. The tortoise does not lose its limbs or stop using them — it retains the ability to pull them in at will, which is the whole point of the comparison.
